system.description:
The Dwarven Arbalest firing rocks: I B3, M B6, S B9, VA –. When firing rocks, it counts as an arquebus for Range and Cover and DoF rules (but no gunpowder die). Loading rocks takes 6 actions. +1D balance die. Purchase the Dwarven Arbalest; this entry is its alternate ammunition.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 125
